All these compounds are linked to A549, the cell line in question. The integration of these pathways implies that Npc115753 may be involved in a signaling network that is modulated by these compounds, which in turn affect A549 cells. The recurring mechanism involves the interaction of Npc115753 with protein kinases, suggesting a possible role in cellular signaling pathways that are influenced by the compounds targeting these kinases.
